title: League of Legends Gold Share Analysis (DSC 80)
description: Developed an end-to-end data science pipeline analyzing 10,000+ professional League matches to investigate gold-share dynamics between Mid Laners and ADCs and their impact on match results. Used a Random Forest Classifier to achieve a 76.21% model accuracy, improving over the 72.39% baseline accuracy from a Logistic Regression model.

title: Spoilage (VGDC)
description: Worked on a team of 150+ members consisting of programmers, artists, and designers to develop a 2D psychological horror cooking/doorman sim on Unity across a ten-week development cycle for VGDC's The Chanel Project (TCP). Helped program core gameplay logic, including timer systems, object-snapping and placement mechanics, and recipe-checking logic.

title: Mahou Boutique (VGDC)
description: Collaborated on a small team featuring designers, artists, and programmers to develop a 2D turn-based RPG on Unity across a six-week development cycle for VGDC's Project Forge (now known as Project Flare). Helped program core gameplay logic such as player health logic, stats tracking, and turn progression systems.

title: Persuasive or Deceptive Visualization? (DSC 106)
description: A group project investigating a dataset of civilian complaints against NYPD officers from 1985-2020, pairing our claim with both persusaive supporting and opposing visualizations for each side. Explained our design choices and rationale for each visual, ranking how deceptive they are on a diverging scale from -2 to 2 (from fully deceptive to fully earnest).
